reason: The primary CIF is parseable and symmetry-expands as claimed: primitive Pma2 (No. 28), a=7.2592, b=5.8532, c=3.3796 A, 16 fully occupied atoms, Na2V4O10 (Z=2; reduced NaV2O5). The orthorhombic indexing is strong (M(20)=110.5 and all 32 clear lines are position-indexed), but the atomic realization is not established. The trace's instantiated-CIF intensity score is 0.5084 and shows decisive mismatches, including observed/calculated normalized intensities of 100/14.1 at 26.35 degrees, 16.9/1.78 at 46.51 degrees, 1.75/13.7 at 36.29 degrees, and 0.57/9.22 at 48.13 degrees; no whole-profile refinement, Pawley-relative bound, or independent coordinate convergence repairs this. An independent fixed-CIF profile convolution likewise leaves a normalized profile residual about 0.745, far above the approximately 0.107 low-intensity noise. Chemistry also fails to validate the model: periodic minima include Na-O 1.817 A and O-O 1.899 A, one O site has no V neighbor nearer than 3.21 A, and bond-valence assignment fails. Thus the indexed cell is credible but the submitted coordinate/topology solution is dubious, and another attempt is likely to produce a materially different viable atomic model.
